description: This file contains type declarations and imports related to the MongoDB Node.js driver, specifically defining types, classes, interfaces, and external references used for interacting with MongoDB databases, collections, cursors, change streams, and encryption features.

methods.name: insertOne
methods.description: Inserts a single document into the collection, automatically adding an _id if not provided.

methods.name: insertMany
methods.description: Inserts multiple documents into the collection, adding _id to those missing it.

methods.name: bulkWrite
methods.description: Performs bulk write operations including insert, update, delete.

methods.name: updateOne
methods.description: Updates a single document matching the filter.

methods.name: replaceOne
methods.description: Replaces a single document matching the filter.

methods.name: updateMany
methods.description: Updates multiple documents matching the filter.

methods.name: deleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a single document matching the filter.

methods.name: deleteMany
methods.description: Deletes multiple documents matching the filter.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames the collection.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Drops the collection from the database, removing it permanently.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Finds a single document matching the filter.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Creates a cursor to find documents matching the filter.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns the collection's options.

methods.name: isCapped
methods.description: Checks if the collection is capped.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates an index on the collection.

methods.name: createIndexes
methods.description: Creates multiple indexes.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index by name.

methods.name: dropIndexes
methods.description: Drops all indexes.

methods.name: listIndexes
methods.description: Lists all indexes on the collection.

methods.name: indexExists
methods.description: Checks if an index exists in the collection.

methods.name: indexInformation
methods.description: Retrieves index information.

methods.name: estimatedDocumentCount
methods.description: Provides an estimate of the document count.

methods.name: countDocuments
methods.description: Counts documents matching a filter.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Returns distinct values for a field.

methods.name: indexes
methods.description: Retrieves all index descriptions.

methods.name: findOneAndDelete
methods.description: Finds one document and deletes it atomically.

methods.name: findOneAndReplace
methods.description: Finds one document and replaces it atomically.

methods.name: findOneAndUpdate
methods.description: Finds one document and updates it atomically.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Runs an aggregation pipeline.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Creates a change stream to watch modifications in the collection.

methods.name: initializeUnorderedBulkOp
methods.description: Starts an unordered bulk operation.

methods.name: initializeOrderedBulkOp
methods.description: Starts an ordered bulk operation.

methods.name: withTransaction
methods.description: Runs a callback within a transaction with automatic commit or abort.

classes.name: Collection
classes.description: The Collection class enables interactions with a MongoDB collection, including CRUD operations, index management, aggregation, change streams, and bulk operations.

classes.name: ClientEncryption
classes.description: Provides explicit encryption and decryption capabilities for MongoDB client-side encryption (CSFLE).

classes.name: ClientSession
classes.description: Represents a client session for server-side transaction management and causal consistency.

classes.name: ServerHeartbeatSucceededEvent
classes.description: Represents a successful server heartbeat event, providing details such as connection id, duration, reply document, and streaming protocol status.

classes.name: ServerOpeningEvent
classes.description: Emitted when a server connection is initialized, contains a topology ID and server address.

classes.name: ServerSession
classes.description: Represents a server session, tracking session ID, last use time, transaction number, and dirty state, with internal timeout checks.

classes.name: ServerSessionId
classes.description: Encapsulates the identifier for a server session, wrapping a Binary ID.

classes.name: StreamDescription
classes.description: Provides a description of a server stream, including address, server type, version info, size limits, compression, session timeout, and server connection ID.

classes.name: StreamDescriptionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for stream description including compressors, session timeout, and load balancing.

classes.name: StrictFilter
classes.description: Typed filter for strict matching in queries, including nested path handling.

classes.name: StrictMatchKeysAndValues
classes.description: Strictly typed key-value pair matching for querying documents with nested paths and array elements.

classes.name: SupportedNodeConnectionOptions
classes.description: Union type representing supported configurations for node connections, combining TLS and socket options.

classes.name: SupportedSocketOptions
classes.description: Subset of node socket options permitted, capturing TCP socket configuration.

classes.name: SupportedTLSConnectionOptions
classes.description: TLS-specific connection options that are supported.

classes.name: SupportedTLSSocketOptions
classes.description: Subset of TLSSocketOptions supported for the connection.

classes.name: TopologyClosedEvent
classes.description: Event emitted when a topology is closed, identified by a unique topology ID.

classes.name: TopologyDescription
classes.description: Represents a deployment topology, including server states, type, set info, and error details.

classes.name: TopologyDescriptionChangedEvent
classes.description: Event triggered when a topology's description changes, includes previous and new descriptions.

classes.name: TopologyOpeningEvent
classes.description: Event emitted when a topology is initialized with a unique ID.

classes.name: TopologyType
classes.description: Enumeration of topology types such as Single, ReplicaSet, Sharded, etc.

classes.name: TopologyVersion
classes.description: Versioning info for topology, including processId and counter.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Internally managed class representing a server transaction, tracking options, server pinning, and recovery tokens.

classes.name: TransactionOptions
classes.description: Configuration for a transaction, including read concern, write concern, read preference, and max commit time.

classes.name: TypedEventEmitter
classes.description: Type-safe event emitter supporting specific event and listener types.

classes.name: UnorderedBulkOperation
classes.description: Represents a bulk write operation that is unordered, allowing adding to operations list with internal handling for errors.

classes.name: UpdateDescription
classes.description: Details of an update, including changed fields, removed fields, array truncations, and disambiguation info.

classes.name: UpdateFilter
classes.description: Type representing filters for updating documents, supporting various operators and nested paths.

classes.name: UpdateManyModel
classes.description: Model defining update operations on multiple documents with optional filtering, upsert, hints, and sorting.

classes.name: UpdateOneModel
classes.description: Model for updating a single document with filter, update, optional array filters, hints, and sorting.

classes.name: UpdateOptions
classes.description: Options for update commands, including array filters, validation bypass, collation, hints, upsert, and variables.

classes.name: UpdateResult
classes.description: Result of an update operation, including matched, modified, upserted counts and IDs.

classes.name: UpdateStatement
classes.description: Represents an update query with filter, update spec, upsert flag, multi-update, collation, hints, and sort.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: Type representing UUIDs used in MongoDB documents.

classes.name: ValidateCollectionOptions
classes.description: Options for background validation of a collection.

classes.name: W
classes.description: Type for write acknowledgment levels, number or 'majority'.

classes.name: WriteConcern
classes.description: Represents the write acknowledgment level and options for write operations.

classes.name: WriteConcernError
classes.description: Represents a failure to meet a write concern, encapsulating error details.

classes.name: WriteConcernErrorData
classes.description: Data structure for error details within a WriteConcernError.

classes.name: WriteConcernErrorResult
classes.description: Structured result of a write concern error, including code, message, and labels.

classes.name: WriteConcernOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for specifying write concern levels.

classes.name: WriteConcernSettings
classes.description: Options for write concern including acknowledgment, timeouts, and journaling flags.

classes.name: WriteError
classes.description: Error indicating failure during a bulk write operation, with details and original operation info.
